source_review.notes: Checked RFC 9110 implementation-independent HTTP interface semantics; OpenAPI 3.2.0 language-agnostic interface scope; Cockburn's original Ports and Adapters article; and durable architecture, domain modeling, and enterprise application references.

evidence: Reviewed dependency ranks, runtime/source arrows, mapping pipeline, partial domain transition, and outcome algebra notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Symbols are defined and TeX is contained in GitHub-supported delimiters.

evidence: Executed the five-edge dependency audit and independently verified zero inward-policy violations and zero domain external dependencies.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Printed counts and empty sets match the declared graph.

evidence: Checked rank inequality for transport-to-application and application-to-domain edges, application-owned port inversion, and each typed mapping stage.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Runtime control and source ownership are not conflated.

evidence: Reviewed malformed transport, prohibited fields, tenant spoofing, null/absence, lazy serialization, stale versions, unique violations, partial commit, remote timeout, lost response, retry, concealed authorization, and excessive indirection.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Trust, type, transaction, failure, concurrency, and operational boundaries are distinguished.

evidence: Checked responsibility ownership, trusted-context separation, explicit mapping, domain mechanism independence, application-owned ports, one use-case transaction, typed outcomes, safe error translation, and boundary tests across examples and answers.
invariant_checking.notes: No import-graph check is presented as proof of semantic architecture.

proof_review.notes: No formal theorem or universal architectural proof is claimed.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No proof sketch is claimed; dependency conditions are engineering invariants.

evidence: The executable audit explicitly limits itself to source dependencies and disclaims runtime calls and architectural quality; unit, adapter, contract, integration, and end-to-end evidence remain distinct.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Local execution does not establish deployed behavior or universal correctness.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed four semantic worlds, HTTP adapter duties, use-case inputs, trusted context, orchestration, domain isolation, ports, dependency inversion, mapping, model separation, validation, outcomes, transactions, nondeterminism, observability, enforcement, tests, and proportionality.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed mass assignment, framework and ORM leakage, explicit failure translation, unit-of-work scope, outbox workflow, remote timeout, idempotency, composition root, generated edges, architecture tests, and operational telemetry safety.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed dense retrieval material, one executable graph audit, ten distinct worked examples, and five exercises progressing from responsibility classification through trace, diagnosis, design comparison, and distributed workflow transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
